Review this change for security vulnerabilities.

Changed files (you may Read these and any other file in the repo):
  - .github/workflows/ci.yml
  - Apps/Tuist.swift
  - bootstrap.sh
  - mise.toml

Unified diff (only + lines are new):

=== DIFF: .github/workflows/ci.yml ===
@@ -14,6 +14,10 @@ env:
   GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
   MISE_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
   MISE_GITHUB_GITHUB_ATTESTATIONS: false
+  # Read by Apps/Tuist.swift at generation. Off for every job by default — with the
+  # COMPILATION_CACHE_* settings baked in but no cache service, each compile task
+  # waits out a CAS socket deadline. app-build flips it on once its service is up.
+  TUIST_CACHE_ENABLED: "false"
 
 jobs:
   lint:
@@ -115,6 +119,23 @@ jobs:
         working-directory: Apps
         run: mise x -- tuist auth login || echo "::warning::No tuist.dev session — this run's build insights go unrecorded."
 
+      # The compilation cache answers only through the service `tuist setup cache`
+      # starts, so the env flips to true strictly after its socket is live — settings
+      # baked in with no service behind them stall every compile task instead (the
+      # workflow-level default covers forks, which have no session to set it up with).
+      - name: Set up Tuist cache
+        if: ${{ !github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork }}
+        working-directory: Apps
+        run: |
+          mise x -- tuist setup cache || true
+          SOCK="$HOME/.local/state/tuist/alexey1312_reachy-mini-swift.sock"
+          for _ in $(seq 1 10); do [ -S "$SOCK" ] && break; sleep 1; done
+          if [ -S "$SOCK" ]; then
+            echo "TUIST_CACHE_ENABLED=true" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
+          else
+            echo "::warning::Tuist cache service did not start — building uncached."
+          fi
+
       # `build:app` generates the project first (depends = ["project"]).
       - name: Build ReachyMini
         run: mise run build:app


=== DIFF: Apps/Tuist.swift ===
@@ -6,6 +6,12 @@ let tuist = Tuist(
         // A set `fullHandle` otherwise makes generation require a tuist.dev session, which
         // CI and forks have none of. The project itself is connected; what is optional here
         // is the session, not the connection.
-        generationOptions: .options(optionalAuthentication: true)
+        // Caching needs the local cache service from `tuist setup cache` (a LaunchAgent);
+        // bootstrap.sh runs it. Without the daemon every compile task waits out a CAS
+        // socket deadline, so CI enables it only after its own setup step succeeds.
+        generationOptions: .options(
+            optionalAuthentication: true,
+            enableCaching: Environment.cacheEnabled.getBoolean(default: true)
+        )
     )
 )


=== DIFF: bootstrap.sh ===
@@ -30,6 +30,17 @@ echo "==> Enabling Git LFS for this clone"
 # Install only the local filters so git-lfs does not reject those existing hooks.
 ./bin/mise x -- git lfs install --local --skip-repo
 
+# Apps/Tuist.swift enables the Xcode compilation cache by default, and the cache
+# only answers through this per-user LaunchAgent — without it every compile task
+# waits out a CAS socket deadline. Needs a tuist.dev session, hence best-effort.
+echo "==> Setting up the Tuist Xcode cache service (LaunchAgent)"
+TUIST="$(./bin/mise where tuist)/tuist"
+(cd Apps && env -u TOOLCHAINS "$TUIST" setup cache) || {
+  echo "WARNING: tuist setup cache failed — no tuist.dev session?"
+  echo "         Run './bin/mise x -- tuist auth login' and re-run bootstrap,"
+  echo "         or generate with TUIST_CACHE_ENABLED=false to build uncached."
+}
+
 echo "==> Done"
 ./bin/mise run setup
 echo ""


=== DIFF: mise.toml ===
@@ -366,6 +366,23 @@ TUIST="$(./bin/mise where tuist)/tuist"
 cd Apps && exec "$TUIST" inspect bundle "$BUNDLE"
 '''
 
+[tasks.share]
+description = "Upload a built app to tuist.dev Previews and print the share link"
+# The Debug-iphoneos default is the `mise run device` product: signed with the personal
+# team, so the preview installs on registered devices — the unsigned CI build would not.
+run = '''
+#!/bin/bash
+set -euo pipefail
+BUNDLE="{{arg(name='bundle', default='Apps/DerivedData/Build/Products/Debug-iphoneos/ReachyMini.app')}}"
+if [ ! -e "$BUNDLE" ]; then
+  echo "No bundle at $BUNDLE — run 'mise run device -- --build-only' first." >&2
+  exit 1
+fi
+BUNDLE="$(cd "$(dirname "$BUNDLE")" && pwd)/$(basename "$BUNDLE")"
+TUIST="$(./bin/mise where tuist)/tuist"
+cd Apps && exec env -u TOOLCHAINS "$TUIST" share "$BUNDLE"
+'''
+
 [tasks.clean]
 description = "Clean build artifacts"
 run = "swift package clean && rm -rf .build"


Investigate per the method in your instructions, then return the findings list.

1	#!/bin/sh
2	# =============================================================================
3	# ReachyMini development environment bootstrap
4	# =============================================================================
5	# The single entry point for setting up this repo after cloning. Idempotent.
6	# Installs all pinned tools via the self-contained ./bin/mise and wires git
7	# hooks. No global mise, brew, or manual tool installs required.
8	#
9	# Swift itself is managed by swiftly (https://www.swift.org/swiftly/) via the
10	# .swift-version file — install swiftly separately if `swift --version`
11	# doesn't match .swift-version.
12	# =============================================================================
13	set -eu
14	cd "$(dirname "$0")"
15	
16	echo "==> Trusting mise config"
17	./bin/mise trust --yes mise.toml
18	
19	echo "==> Installing pinned tools (swiftformat, swiftlint, hk, dprint, tuist, ...)"
20	./bin/mise install
21	
22	echo "==> Wiring git hooks (.githooks via core.hooksPath)"
23	git config core.hooksPath .githooks
24	chmod +x .githooks/*
25	
26	# Snapshot reference images are LFS pointers; without the filter they check out as text stubs
27	# and every snapshot test fails with an unreadable-image error.
28	echo "==> Enabling Git LFS for this clone"
29	# LFS hooks are tracked in .githooks and combined with hk where necessary.
30	# Install only the local filters so git-lfs does not reject those existing hooks.
31	./bin/mise x -- git lfs install --local --skip-repo
32	
33	# Apps/Tuist.swift enables the Xcode compilation cache by default, and the cache
34	# only answers through this per-user LaunchAgent — without it every compile task
35	# waits out a CAS socket deadline. Needs a tuist.dev session, hence best-effort.
36	echo "==> Setting up the Tuist Xcode cache service (LaunchAgent)"
37	TUIST="$(./bin/mise where tuist)/tuist"
38	(cd Apps && env -u TOOLCHAINS "$TUIST" setup cache) || {
39	  echo "WARNING: tuist setup cache failed — no tuist.dev session?"
40	  echo "         Run './bin/mise x -- tuist auth login' and re-run bootstrap,"
41	  echo "         or generate with TUIST_CACHE_ENABLED=false to build uncached."
42	}
43	
44	echo "==> Done"
45	./bin/mise run setup
46	echo ""
47	echo "Next steps:"
48	echo "  ./bin/mise run build   # build the Swift package"
49	echo "  ./bin/mise run test    # run tests"
50	echo "  ./bin/mise tasks       # list all tasks"
51

1	# =============================================================================
2	# mise Configuration for ReachyMini
3	# =============================================================================
4	# Bootstrap: run ./bootstrap.sh once after cloning. No global mise needed —
5	# ./bin/mise is a self-contained bootstrap binary (mise generate bootstrap).
6	#
7	# To update the embedded mise version:
8	#   mise generate bootstrap > ./bin/mise && chmod +x ./bin/mise
9	# =============================================================================
10	
11	[settings]
12	experimental = true
13	legacy_version_file = false
14	
15	# Safety net for developers who skipped ./bootstrap.sh: wire git hooks on
16	# directory entry via the native core.hooksPath mechanism.
17	[hooks]
18	enter = """
19	git config core.hooksPath .githooks 2>/dev/null || true
20	"""
21	
22	[tools]
23	# --- Swift Development ---
24	# Swift itself is managed by swiftly via .swift-version, not by mise.
25	swiftformat = "0.62.1" # Swift code formatting
26	swiftlint = "0.65.0"   # Swift linting
27	xcsift = "1.3.1"       # xcodebuild/swift output filtering
28	tuist = "4.203.1"      # Xcode project generation (Apps/)
29	
30	# --- Documentation & Formatting ---
31	dprint = "0.55.2" # Markdown formatting
32	
33	# --- Snapshots & Storybook ---
34	# The release ships a single lowercase `prefire` binary, which the backend cannot guess from the
35	# repository name — hence the explicit exe option.
36	"github:BarredEwe/Prefire[exe=prefire]" = "5.7.0"
37	git-lfs = "3.7.1" # Snapshot reference images
38	
39	# --- Git & CI ---
40	hk = "1.54.0"         # Git hooks manager (version must match hk.pkl package URI)
41	actionlint = "1.7.12" # GitHub Actions linting
42	git-cliff = "2.13.1"  # Changelog generation
43	
44	# --- Simulator ---
45	python = "3.12" # for sim-daemon venv: mujoco ships no wheels for newer pythons
46	uv = "0.12.1"   # installs into that venv as APFS clones — see sim-daemon
47	
48	[tasks.build]
49	description = "Build the Swift package (debug)"
50	run = """
51	set -o pipefail
52	swift build 2>&1 | xcsift
53	"""
54	
55	[tasks."build:release"]
56	description = "Build the Swift package (release)"
57	run = """
58	set -o pipefail
59	swift build --configuration release 2>&1 | xcsift
60	"""
61	
62	# `build` and `test` are SwiftPM only — Apps/ReachyMini is an Xcode target and
63	# nothing else compiles it. Signing is off: the runner has no team, and the
64	# personal one lives in CLAUDE.local.md.
65	[tasks."build:app"]
66	description = "Build the ReachyMini app target (macOS)"
67	depends = ["project"]
68	# `-resultBundlePath` is what makes build insights reach tuist.dev. Tuist writes a
69	# `tuist inspect build` post-action into every generated scheme, and it reads the
70	# .xcactivitylog that xcodebuild only writes when a result bundle is requested — Xcode.app
71	# writes one unconditionally, which is why local Xcode builds were the only ones ever
72	# recorded. Without the flag the post-action fails with "couldn't find the most recent
73	# activity log" and, being a post-action, leaves the build green.
74	run = '''
75	set -o pipefail
76	RESULT_BUNDLE=Apps/DerivedData/ResultBundles/ReachyMini-macOS.xcresult
77	rm -rf "$RESULT_BUNDLE"
78	xcodebuild -workspace Apps/ReachyMiniApps.xcworkspace -scheme ReachyMini \
79	  -destination 'platform=macOS' -configuration Debug \
80	  -derivedDataPath Apps/DerivedData \
81	  -resultBundlePath "$RESULT_BUNDLE" \
82	  CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO \
83	  -skipPackagePluginValidation -skipMacroValidation \
84	  build 2>&1 | xcsift
85	'''
86	
87	# The macOS build above cannot see ReachyWidget: the extension is iOS-only and
88	# Project.swift embeds it with `condition: .when([.ios])`, so under `platform=macOS`
89	# it is not built at all. `generic/platform=iOS` compiles it without needing a
90	# device, a simulator or a signing identity.
91	[tasks."build:app:ios"]
92	description = "Build the ReachyMini app and its widget extension (iOS, unsigned)"
93	depends = ["project"]
94	run = '''
95	set -o pipefail
96	RESULT_BUNDLE=Apps/DerivedData/ResultBundles/ReachyMini-iOS.xcresult
97	rm -rf "$RESULT_BUNDLE"
98	xcodebuild -workspace Apps/ReachyMiniApps.xcworkspace -scheme ReachyMini \
99	  -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -configuration Debug \
100	  -derivedDataPath Apps/DerivedData \
101	  -resultBundlePath "$RESULT_BUNDLE" \
102	  CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO \
103	  -skipPackagePluginValidation -skipMacroValidation \
104	  build 2>&1 | xcsift
105	'''
106	
107	# Release builds exist to guard archive-ability: nothing else compiles the
108	# Release configuration, so a broken one would first surface at archive time.
109	[tasks."build:app:release"]
110	description = "Build the ReachyMini app target (macOS, Release, unsigned)"
111	depends = ["project"]
112	run = '''
113	set -o pipefail
114	RESULT_BUNDLE=Apps/DerivedData/ResultBundles/ReachyMini-macOS-release.xcresult
115	rm -rf "$RESULT_BUNDLE"
116	xcodebuild -workspace Apps/ReachyMiniApps.xcworkspace -scheme ReachyMini \
117	  -destination 'platform=macOS' -configuration Release \
118	  -derivedDataPath Apps/DerivedData \
119	  -resultBundlePath "$RESULT_BUNDLE" \
120	  CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO \
121	  -skipPackagePluginValidation -skipMacroValidation \
122	  build 2>&1 | xcsift
123	'''
124	
125	[tasks."build:app:ios:release"]
126	description = "Build the ReachyMini app and widget (iOS, Release, unsigned)"
127	depends = ["project"]
128	run = '''
129	set -o pipefail
130	RESULT_BUNDLE=Apps/DerivedData/ResultBundles/ReachyMini-iOS-release.xcresult
131	rm -rf "$RESULT_BUNDLE"
132	xcodebuild -workspace Apps/ReachyMiniApps.xcworkspace -scheme ReachyMini \
133	  -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -configuration Release \
134	  -derivedDataPath Apps/DerivedData \
135	  -resultBundlePath "$RESULT_BUNDLE" \
136	  CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO \
137	  -skipPackagePluginValidation -skipMacroValidation \
138	  build 2>&1 | xcsift
139	'''
140	
141	[tasks.device]
142	description = "Build, install and launch on a connected iPhone (see Scripts/device-run.sh)"
143	depends = ["project"]
144	run = "./Scripts/device-run.sh"
145	
146	[tasks."release:ios"]
147	description = "Archive the iOS app and upload it to TestFlight (see Scripts/release-ios.sh)"
148	depends = ["project"]
149	run = "./Scripts/release-ios.sh"
150	
151	[tasks."release:macos"]
152	description = "Archive, notarize and zip the macOS app (see Scripts/release-macos.sh)"
153	depends = ["project"]
154	run = "./Scripts/release-macos.sh"
155	
156	[tasks.test]
157	description = "Run all tests (parallel)"
158	# --skip-build against a separate build step: building and testing at once hangs.
159	run = """
160	set -o pipefail
161	swift build --build-tests 2>&1 | xcsift
162	swift test --skip-build --parallel 2>&1 | xcsift
163	"""
164	
165	[tasks."test:filter"]
166	description = "Run tests with filter (usage: mise run test:filter ReachyKitTests)"
167	run = """
168	set -o pipefail
169	swift test --parallel --filter {{arg(name='filter')}} 2>&1 | xcsift
170	"""
171	
172	# Smoke tests boot the actual app binary on a simulator — the one wiring nothing
173	# else exercises. No OS pin: unlike the snapshot suite these assert on structure,
174	# not pixels, so whatever runtime the machine has is fine. Labels are matched in
175	# English, hence the pinned test language (the snapshot suite's trade).
176	[tasks."test:smoke"]
177	description = "Launch the app on a simulator and smoke the connect gate (XCUITest)"
178	depends = ["project"]
179	run = '''
180	set -o pipefail
181	SIM="${REACHY_SMOKE_SIM:-iPhone 17 Pro}"
182	xcrun simctl boot "$SIM" 2>/dev/null || true
183	xcodebuild test -workspace Apps/ReachyMiniApps.xcworkspace -scheme ReachyMini \
184	  -destination "platform=iOS Simulator,name=${SIM}" \
185	  -derivedDataPath Apps/DerivedData \
186	  -testLanguage en -testRegion US \
187	  CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO \
188	  -skipPackagePluginValidation -skipMacroValidation \
189	  2>&1 | xcsift
190	'''
191	
192	[tasks."test:smoke:sim"]
193	description = "Smoke the whole user path against a running sim daemon (start with: mise run sim-daemon)"
194	depends = ["project"]
195	run = '''
196	set -o pipefail
197	SIM="${REACHY_SMOKE_SIM:-iPhone 17 Pro}"
198	xcrun simctl boot "$SIM" 2>/dev/null || true
199	# TEST_RUNNER_ forwards the variable into the XCUITest runner's environment.
200	xcodebuild test -workspace Apps/ReachyMiniApps.xcworkspace -scheme ReachyMini \
201	  -destination "platform=iOS Simulator,name=${SIM}" \
202	  -derivedDataPath Apps/DerivedData \
203	  -testLanguage en -testRegion US \
204	  CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO \
205	  TEST_RUNNER_REACHY_SMOKE_HOST="${REACHY_SMOKE_HOST:-127.0.0.1:8000}" \
206	  -skipPackagePluginValidation -skipMacroValidation \
207	  2>&1 | xcsift
208	'''
209	
210	[tasks."test:sim"]
211	description = "Integration tests against a running sim daemon (start with: mise run sim-daemon)"
212	run = """
213	set -o pipefail
214	REACHY_SIM_HOST=127.0.0.1 swift test --parallel --filter SimulatorIntegrationTests 2>&1 | xcsift
215	"""
216	
217	# Snapshots run on an iOS simulator, so they live in Apps/ as an Xcode target and never reach
218	# `swift test`. Both the device and the OS are pinned: a different runtime renders text
219	# differently and every reference would have to be re-recorded.
220	[tasks."snapshots:_run"]
221	hide = true
222	depends = ["project"]
223	run = '''
224	set -o pipefail
225	SIM="${REACHY_SNAPSHOT_SIM:-iPhone 17 Pro}"
226	# Belt and braces since the forked template took over: each preview is captured in both
227	# appearances from an injected trait, and the surfaces gallery re-recorded on a *dark* simulator
228	# came out byte-identical, so the trait decides. Left here for whatever the trait does not reach.
229	xcrun simctl boot "$SIM" 2>/dev/null || true
230	xcrun simctl ui "$SIM" appearance light >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
231	# References are English-only on purpose. Every string this app shows is localizable, and a
232	# simulator left in another language would re-render all 1000 of them in it.
233	xcodebuild test -workspace Apps/ReachyMiniApps.xcworkspace -scheme ReachyUISnapshotTests \
234	  -destination "platform=iOS Simulator,name=${SIM},OS=${REACHY_SNAPSHOT_OS:-26.4.1}" \
235	  -derivedDataPath Apps/DerivedData \
236	  -testLanguage en -testRegion US \
237	  CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO \
238	  -skipPackagePluginValidation -skipMacroValidation \
239	  2>&1 | xcsift
240	'''
241	
242	[tasks."test:snapshots"]
243	description = "Snapshot-test every ReachyUI preview (fails if a reference had to be recorded)"
244	run = '''
245	#!/bin/bash
246	set -euo pipefail
247	DIR=Apps/ReachyUISnapshotTests/__Snapshots__
248	# Prefire generates `record: .missing`, so an absent reference is written rather than compared.
249	# Comparing the images either side of the run reports that as a failure even if the suite itself
250	# is happy — a reference that had to be written verified nothing. Checksums rather than
251	# `git status`, so an uncommitted tree does not read as a failure.
252	fingerprint() { find "$DIR" -name '*.png' -exec shasum -a 256 {} + 2>/dev/null | sort; }
253	BEFORE="$(fingerprint)"
254	./bin/mise run snapshots:_run
255	AFTER="$(fingerprint)"
256	if [ "$BEFORE" != "$AFTER" ]; then
257	  echo "Snapshot references were written during the run, so they verified nothing:" >&2
258	  diff <(echo "$BEFORE") <(echo "$AFTER") >&2 || true
259	  echo "Review the images, or re-record them all with: mise run test:snapshots:record" >&2
260	  exit 1
261	fi
262	'''
263	
264	[tasks."test:snapshots:record"]
265	description = "Delete and re-record every snapshot reference, leaving the diff for review"
266	run = '''
267	#!/bin/bash
268	set -euo pipefail
269	DIR=Apps/ReachyUISnapshotTests/__Snapshots__
270	# `record: .missing` only writes absent references, so re-recording means removing them first.
271	[ -d "$DIR" ] && find "$DIR" -name '*.png' -delete
272	# swift-snapshot-testing reports a freshly recorded reference as a test failure, which is the
273	# expected outcome here — the point of this task is to write them.
274	./bin/mise run snapshots:_run || true
275	git status --short -- "$DIR"
276	'''
277	
278	[tasks.storybook]
279	description = "Regenerate the preview catalogue and run the storybook app on a simulator"
280	run = '''
281	#!/bin/bash
282	set -euo pipefail
283	SIM="${REACHY_SNAPSHOT_SIM:-iPhone 17 Pro}"
284	# The playbook plugin only ever scans its own target's sources, so the CLI is driven directly.
285	prefire playbook Sources/ReachyDesign/Previews Sources/ReachyUI/Previews Apps/ReachyMini/Previews \
286	  --output Apps/ReachyStorybook/Generated \
287	  --config Apps
288	./bin/mise run project
289	set -o pipefail
290	xcodebuild -workspace Apps/ReachyMiniApps.xcworkspace -scheme ReachyStorybook \
291	  -destination "platform=iOS Simulator,name=$SIM,OS=${REACHY_SNAPSHOT_OS:-26.4.1}" \
292	  -configuration Debug -derivedDataPath Apps/DerivedData \
293	  CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO -skipPackagePluginValidation -skipMacroValidation \
294	  build 2>&1 | xcsift
295	xcrun simctl boot "$SIM" 2>/dev/null || true
296	open -a Simulator
297	xcrun simctl install "$SIM" Apps/DerivedData/Build/Products/Debug-iphonesimulator/ReachyStorybook.app
298	xcrun simctl launch "$SIM" com.alexey1312.ReachyMiniStorybook
299	'''
300	
301	[tasks.lint]
302	description = "Run SwiftLint, actionlint, and the hk version lockstep check"
303	run = '''
304	set -o pipefail
305	PINNED="$(sed -nE 's/^hk = "([0-9.]+)".*/\1/p' mise.toml)"
306	DRIFT="$(grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' hk.pkl | sort -u | grep -vFx "$PINNED" || true)"
307	if [ -n "$DRIFT" ]; then
308	  echo "hk.pkl references $DRIFT but mise.toml pins $PINNED — bump both together." >&2
309	  exit 1
310	fi
311	swiftlint lint --strict Sources Tests Apps/ReachyMini Apps/ReachyMiniUITests Apps/ReachyStorybook Apps/ReachyUISnapshotTests 2>&1 | xcsift
312	actionlint
313	'''
314	
315	[tasks.format]
316	description = "Format all files (Swift + Markdown)"
317	run = "hk fix --all 2>&1 | grep -E '^(✔|✗|hk )' || true"
318	
319	[tasks.format-check]
320	description = "Check all formatting (CI)"
321	run = """
322	set -o pipefail
323	hk check --all 2>&1 | grep -E '^(✔|✗|hk )'
324	"""
325	
326	[tasks.setup]
327	description = "Show git hooks status"
328	run = "echo 'Git hooks:' && git config core.hooksPath && ls .githooks/"
329	
330	[tasks.project]
331	description = "Generate Xcode project for app targets (Apps/)"
332	# Explicit path: /usr/local/bin/tuist (tuistenv) can shadow mise's pinned tuist.
333	# TOOLCHAINS is cleared because tuist 4.203.1 reads only Xcode's version banner
334	# ("swift-driver version: … Apple Swift version …") and aborts on a swift.org
335	# toolchain's ("Apple Swift version 6.3 (swift-6.3-RELEASE)").
336	run = """
337	#!/bin/bash
338	set -euo pipefail
339	# The storybook target globs `Generated/**`, which is gitignored — tuist rejects a glob whose
340	# directory does not exist, so generation fails outright on a fresh clone (and in CI) unless the
341	# playbook is written first. Cheap enough to redo every time.
342	prefire playbook Sources/ReachyDesign/Previews Sources/ReachyUI/Previews Apps/ReachyMini/Previews \
343	  --output Apps/ReachyStorybook/Generated --config Apps
344	TUIST="$(./bin/mise where tuist)/tuist"
345	cd Apps && exec env -u TOOLCHAINS "$TUIST" generate --no-open
346	"""
347	
348	[tasks."inspect:bundle"]
349	description = "Upload an iOS app-bundle size analysis to tuist.dev"
350	# Runs from Apps/ because tuist only searches upward for Tuist.swift; from the repo
351	# root it reports the project as unconnected instead of naming the wrong cwd.
352	run = '''
353	#!/bin/bash
354	set -euo pipefail
355	BUNDLE="{{arg(name='bundle', default='Apps/DerivedData/Build/Products/Debug-iphoneos/ReachyMini.app')}}"
356	if [ ! -e "$BUNDLE" ]; then
357	  echo "No bundle at $BUNDLE — build for a device first (see CLAUDE.local.md)." >&2
358	  exit 1
359	fi
360	BUNDLE="$(cd "$(dirname "$BUNDLE")" && pwd)/$(basename "$BUNDLE")"
361	if [ ! -f "$BUNDLE/Info.plist" ] && [ -f "$BUNDLE/Contents/Info.plist" ]; then
362	  echo "$BUNDLE is a macOS bundle; this command takes the iOS one (Debug-iphoneos)." >&2
363	  exit 1
364	fi
365	TUIST="$(./bin/mise where tuist)/tuist"
366	cd Apps && exec "$TUIST" inspect bundle "$BUNDLE"
367	'''
368	
369	[tasks.share]
370	description = "Upload a built app to tuist.dev Previews and print the share link"
371	# The Debug-iphoneos default is the `mise run device` product: signed with the personal
372	# team, so the preview installs on registered devices — the unsigned CI build would not.
373	run = '''
374	#!/bin/bash
375	set -euo pipefail
376	BUNDLE="{{arg(name='bundle', default='Apps/DerivedData/Build/Products/Debug-iphoneos/ReachyMini.app')}}"
377	if [ ! -e "$BUNDLE" ]; then
378	  echo "No bundle at $BUNDLE — run 'mise run device -- --build-only' first." >&2
379	  exit 1
380	fi
381	BUNDLE="$(cd "$(dirname "$BUNDLE")" && pwd)/$(basename "$BUNDLE")"
382	TUIST="$(./bin/mise where tuist)/tuist"
383	cd Apps && exec env -u TOOLCHAINS "$TUIST" share "$BUNDLE"
384	'''
385	
386	[tasks.clean]
387	description = "Clean build artifacts"
388	run = "swift package clean && rm -rf .build"
389	
390	[tasks.changelog]
391	description = "Generate CHANGELOG.md from git history"
392	run = "git-cliff -o CHANGELOG.md"
393	
394	[tasks.update-spec]
395	description = "Fetch latest daemon OpenAPI spec from pollen-robotics/reachy_mini"
396	run = """
397	curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pollen-robotics/reachy_mini/main/docs/source/API/openapi.json \
398	  -o Sources/ReachyKit/openapi.json
399	python3 Scripts/normalize-openapi.py Sources/ReachyKit/openapi.json
400	git diff --stat Sources/ReachyKit/openapi.json
401	"""
402	
403	[tasks.sim-daemon]
404	description = "Run simulated Reachy Mini daemon (MuJoCo) reachable from LAN devices"
405	run = """
406	#!/bin/bash
407	set -euo pipefail
408	# The venv is created by `python -m venv` (MuJoCo's GUI needs mjpython, which wants a
409	# real framework build) and only *filled* by uv. uv writes each file as an APFS clone
410	# instead of copying it out of its cache, so a second worktree costs ~6 MiB and under a
411	# second rather than 1.3 GB and ten minutes. Measured with the daemon then serving
412	# /api/daemon/status — `uv venv` itself is what was never tried against mujoco.
413	VENV=.venv-sim
414	REQUIREMENTS=Scripts/sim-requirements.txt
415	STAMP="$VENV/.requirements.sha256"
416	EXPECTED="$(shasum -a 256 "$REQUIREMENTS" | awk '{print $1}')"
417	# Explicit path: system PATH can shadow mise's python with an ancient one.
418	PYTHON="$(./bin/mise where python)/bin/python3"
419	INSTALLED="$(test -f "$STAMP" && cat "$STAMP" || true)"
420	if [ ! -x "$VENV/bin/mjpython" ] || [ "$INSTALLED" != "$EXPECTED" ]; then
421	  rm -rf "$VENV"
422	  "$PYTHON" -m venv "$VENV"
423	  uv pip install --quiet --python "$VENV/bin/python" --requirement "$REQUIREMENTS"
424	  printf '%s' "$EXPECTED" > "$STAMP"
425	fi
426	"$VENV/bin/python" -c 'import importlib.metadata as m; assert m.version("reachy-mini") == "1.9.0"'
427	# `gstreamer_python`'s libgstpython.dylib segfaults while GStreamer scans plugins.
428	# Forked (the default) that only surfaces as "External plugin loader failed" and
429	# the daemon then hangs before binding :8000; with GST_REGISTRY_FORK=no the
430	# segfault kills the daemon outright. The pipeline below needs native elements
431	# only, so the plugin is pure liability.
432	find "$VENV" -name libgstpython.dylib -exec mv {} {}.disabled ';' 2>/dev/null || true
433	# Without the scanner GStreamer's plugin loader silently fails, webrtcsink can't
434	# find the Opus encoder ("No caps found for stream audio_0") and no WebRTC
435	# producer is ever registered on :8443.
436	export GST_PLUGIN_SCANNER="$PWD/$VENV/lib/python3.12/site-packages/gstreamer_libs/libexec/gstreamer-1.0/gst-plugin-scanner"
437	exec "$VENV/bin/mjpython" -m reachy_mini.daemon.app.main --sim --fastapi-host 0.0.0.0 "$@"
438	"""
439

content.text:
Looking at the four changed files, this is a build infrastructure change — enabling Tuist's compilation cache with a local cache service, both in bootstrap.sh (dev) and CI. Let me trace each surface systematically.

**ci.yml (lines 17-20, 122-137):**
- `TUIST_CACHE_ENABLED: "false"` at workflow-env level; individual step conditionally sets it to true after socket verification
- New "Set up Tuist cache" step gated on `!github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork`
- The trigger is `pull_request` (not `pull_request_target`), so fork PRs get no secrets regardless
- OIDC id-token permission was pre-existing; the new step doesn't introduce new secret-handling
- Fork check is correct — evaluates true on push events (null pull_request), true on same-repo PRs, false on fork PRs
- Socket path is a fixed literal `$HOME/.local/state/tuist/alexey1312_reachy-mini-swift.sock`, no injection
- `seq`/`sleep` loop is bounded

**Apps/Tuist.swift (lines 12-15):**
- `Environment.cacheEnabled.getBoolean(default: true)` reads the standard `TUIST_CACHE_ENABLED` env var
- Default `true` means local dev enables caching; CI overrides to false unless setup succeeds
- No sinks, no data flow — this is a config plumbing change

**bootstrap.sh (lines 33-42):**
- Local-only setup, fixed command (`tuist setup cache`), no user input
- `env -u TOOLCHAINS` is a hardening measure (unsets a var known to break tuist)
- Runs as the invoking developer, no privilege boundary

**mise.toml (lines 369-384, `[tasks.share]`):**
- New task uploads a built app to tuist.dev Previews
- `bundle` comes from `{{arg}}` mise template — developer-invoked local task
- Interpolation into `cd "$(dirname "$BUNDLE")"` and passed as final arg to `tuist share`
- Only reachable by the developer running `mise run share` themselves; no untrusted caller
- No cross-principal boundary crossed

**Cross-cutting checks:**
- Fork gate parity: `Authenticate` and `Set up Tuist cache` both have the same fork guard — consistent, no sibling handler omitting the check
- Cache poisoning: writes to tuist.dev cache only occur from trusted-principal jobs (post-fork-check); pulls from cache in fork builds are keyed on input hashes — standard trust model
- No new logging of secrets, no new exec sinks receiving external input, no permission grants added

The change is confined to build tooling with correct fork isolation and no new attacker-influenceable data flowing to sinks.
